title: 卡特琳娜·樱桃吐司
description: 红长发卡特琳娜穿完整深色便装，在桌前给吐司摆樱桃，双匕首保持入鞘。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Katarina is an adult Noxian woman with very long vivid red hair, green eyes, a small facial scar, and a confident angular expression. Preserve her black-red leather and silver armor accents while using a fully closed long-sleeved jacket, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. Her paired curved daggers remain securely sheathed at the sides, never drawn or used as kitchen tools.
art_direction.scene: She sits at a little breakfast table and arranges two cherries on a slice of toast with her fingertips, looking unexpectedly pleased by the neat result. A plain jam jar, a spoon, and a small cup complete the setting. The blades stay sheathed, and a warm window gives her sharp silhouette a gentle domestic context.
art_direction.palette: cherry red hair, charcoal black, cream toast, soft silver
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
